content.text: All rules searched. Submitting the plan.

plans.note: Primary clause is § 15.11 Limitation of Liability (p0833) — check mutuality, whether an aggregate cap exists, and carve-outs (indemnity, confidentiality, IP, willful misconduct). Also review the arbitration provision (p0830) which bars consequential/punitive damages and lost profits in arbitration, and cross-check interaction with Article 12 indemnities (sec-p0685) so the same term is not flagged twice.

Mutual indemnities present: SFJ indemnifies PB at § 12.1.1 (p0687); PB indemnifies SFJ (including SFJ's investors) at § 12.1.2 (p0692) — assess breadth of our outbound indemnity and whether SFJ's covers third-party IP claims. Procedure at §§ 12.2.1–12.2.5 (p0698, p0699, p0704, p0705). Tax indemnity at p0524; data-protection indemnity-flavoured language at p0675.

§ 3.19 Exclusivity Commitment (p0369–p0374) binds SFJ, not us — benefits our party, do not flag. Confirm no reciprocal competing-product restriction on PB; the closest PB-side restrictions are the negative covenants (p0544) and the Licensing Transaction consent right (p0552), which limit our freedom to license/commercialize and should be assessed here or under ASSIGN, not double-flagged.

No sole-supplier obligation on PB found. Review Approved CRO / Approved Vendor consent architecture (§ 2.4, p0261–p0264) and § 3.14.2.1 (p0359, SFJ to use only PB-supplied Product) for any de facto restriction on our sourcing freedom; SFJ-side exclusivity at p0369 favours us.
Multiple searches (most favored/favoured, more favorable, no less favorable, comparable terms, match the terms) returned no hits. No MFN obligation appears to burden PB; likely inapplicable/absent.

§ 15.16 Nonsolicitation (p0841) is mutual and runs during the Term plus a redacted tail. Worker to read full paragraph for duration, scope (employees/consultants) and whether a general-advertising / unsolicited-response carve-out exists.

PB has an at-will termination right at § 14.2.2 (p0755) but only after SFJ has funded $60m — check any payment/penalty consequence in § 14.3 (p0782). SFJ's exit rights are broad: Material Adverse Event (p0756), failure to obtain Regulatory Approval (p0757), bankruptcy (p0761), change of control (p0765), safety (p0767), breach (p0771/p0774), adverse patent impact (p0778); cross-refs at p0339–p0345.

§ 14.1 Term (p0746) defines a fixed term tied to the Development Term / final Approval Payment; no auto-renewal or renewal-pricing mechanic located. Worker to confirm from the full paragraph, then likely treat as not applicable rather than a deviation.

§ 15.9 Governing Law (p0822) — confirm which state's law. § 15.10 Dispute Resolution (p0823–p0830) sends disputes to ICDR international arbitration (with IP-ownership disputes carved out per p0824); note the arbitral damages limitation (p0830) and the AAA arbitration for Material Impact determinations (p0553). Assess arbitration-vs-courts and seat against the playbook.

§ 15.6 Assignment (p0814) requires prior written consent — check affiliate/successor carve-outs for PB. Change of Control is defined at p0036–p0037 and triggers a Change of Control Buy-Out Payment (p0038, p0530) and an SFJ termination right (p0765); Licensing Transaction definition references permitted assignment (p0146, p0147).

PB retains Existing PB IP and owns Trial Inventions with SFJ assignment (p0651, p0658, p0659) — favourable. Key issue: SFJ ownership of Research Results until PB buys them back for a redacted payment (p0663) and the Research Results/Trial Data Package definitions (p0196, p0227). Also flow-down IP terms in CRO/Vendor/Site agreements (p0262, p0263, p0289) and PII handling (p0672–p0677, p0335).

No conventional vendor-to-customer licence grant; the relevant grants run the other way. Worker to read Article 11 (sec-p0647) for any licence/right-of-reference to SFJ, the security interest grant over PB IP-related collateral (p0537), the Licensing Transaction / Excluded Licensing Transaction definitions (p0146, p0084) restricting our ability to sublicense, and the non-exclusive licence Permitted Lien carve-out (p0598).

Article 9 Records (p0623–p0625) requires GAAP accounting records and Development records 'in sufficient detail to verify compliance' — read for any SFJ inspection right, notice, frequency and cost allocation. § 3.6 Audits (p0320–p0322) covers quality audits of Permitted Third Parties/manufacturing; financial reporting to SFJ at p0367.

No liquidated-damages clause as such. Assess § 6.4 Late Payments interest (p0523) for a punitive rate, the Buy-Out Payment mechanics (p0526, p0527, p0530) and § 14.3 additional consequences of termination (p0782) for termination-fee-like amounts payable by PB. Avoid double-flagging amounts already handled under T4C/ASSIGN.

Warranty package is heavily PB-side (p0729–p0737, p0563); SFJ gives only corporate authority (p0720, p0721) plus a funding covenant (§ 13.5, p0739). Disclaimer at § 13.6 (p0740, p0742) disclaims any warranty as to Clinical Trial outcome. Worker to assess whether SFJ warrants performance of the SFJ Services to a professional standard and note the asymmetry.

§ 12.3 Insurance (p0706–p0709) requires each Party to carry coverage meeting § 12.3.2 minimums (amounts redacted); p0713 covers Professional Liability in lieu of Clinical Trial Insurance. Check SFJ-side limits, certificate/notice obligations (p0708) and additional-insured/waiver terms.

No purchase/volume commitment on PB. Nearest analogue is the funding architecture: Maximum Development Costs of $120m with excess borne by PB (p0380, p0381) and the Elected Total Amount floor of $110m that PB must elect (p0399) — assess whether that floor operates as a take-or-pay-style commitment, and whether the § 14.2.2 exit mitigates it.

§ 14.3 (p0782) sets termination consequences, including SFJ's obligation to transfer Product Filings and provide assistance/cooperation to PB (p0784) and orderly wind-down (p0788). Return of Confidential Information at § 10.3 (p0640) and MedImmune-specific terms at p0641. Also review the Research Results buy-back (p0663), Program Transfer Notice mechanics (p0376) and Product Filing assignment (p0277, p0279) for adequacy of our data-return and transition rights.
